ex.s: The dumplings arrive steaming and dangerously hot.
ex.t: 饺子热气腾腾地上桌，烫得吓人。

ex.s: Nanxiang aside, the best Xiao long bao have a fine skin, allowing them ____41____ (lift) out of the steamer basket without allowing them tearing or spilling any of ____42____ (they) contents.
ex.t: 撇开南翔不谈，最好的小笼包皮薄，能让它们被____41____（lift）从蒸笼里取出而不会破皮，也不会洒出____42____（they）里面的东西。

ex.s: No matter where I buy them, one steamer is ____44____ (rare) enough, yet two seems greedy, so I am always left _____45_____ (want) more next time.
ex.t: 无论我在哪里买，一笼总是____44____（rare）不够，但两笼又显得贪心，所以我总是_____45_____（want）期待下次再多吃点。

ex.s: To frame his story, Klein creates the character of Ned, a fictional witness to the progress brought about by the steams and electric revolutions in America during one man's lifetime.
ex.t: 为了构建他的故事，克莱因创造了内德这个人物，一个虚构的见证者，见证了一生之中美国蒸汽与电气革命带来的进步。

defs.def: the power that is produced from steam under pressure, used to operate engines, machines, etc. 蒸汽动力

ex.s: Yet properly understood, the age of electricity is merely the second stage in the age of steam, which began a century earlier.
ex.t: 然而正确理解的话，电气时代不过是早一个世纪开始的蒸汽时代的第二个阶段。

ex.s: "It is curious that no one has put together a history of both the steam and electric revolutions." writes Maury Klein in his book The Power Makers, Steam, Electricity, and the Men Invented Modem America.
ex.t: 奇怪的是，竟没有人把蒸汽和电气两次革命的历史合在一起写，莫里·克莱因在《造电者：蒸汽、电力与发明现代美国的人》一书中写道。

ex.s: Klein writes, "America did not invent the steam engine, but once they grasped its passwords they put it to more uses than anyone else. "
ex.t: 克莱因写道：“美国没有发明蒸汽机，但一旦他们掌握了它的密码，就用得比任何人都多。”

ex.s: It is closely linked to the steam age.
ex.t: 它与蒸汽时代紧密相连。

ex.s: Then Jeff noticed steam shooting out of the pot and the lid starting to shake.
ex.t: 这时杰夫注意到锅里冒出蒸汽，锅盖开始晃动。

ex.s: We've all known people who run out of steam before they reach life's halfway mark． I'm not talking about those who fail to get to the top． We can't all get there． I'm talking about people who have stopped learning on growing because they have adopted the fixed attitudes and opinions that all too often come with passing years．
ex.t: 我们都认识那些在人生过半前就耗尽动力的人。我不是说那些没能爬到顶的人。我们不可能都到顶。我说的是那些停止学习和成长的人，因为他们采取了伴随着岁月而来的、太过常见的固定态度和看法。

ex.t: 蒸汽机____65__（被用于）拉动车厢，对于乘客来说一定____66__（相当）不愉快——到处都是烟雾和噪音。

to increase speed gradually 车辆
to send out steam 蒸发；散发蒸汽；冒水汽

ex.s: I was just letting off steam really, because I was so angry, but then my friend went and told everyone else what I’d said.
ex.t: 我其实只是发泄一下，因为太生气了，但后来我朋友跑去把我说的话告诉了所有人。

ex.s: Then there were the great Western inventions: the steam engine, the telephone and the radio.
ex.t: 后来出现了伟大的西方发明:蒸汽机,电话和无线电.

ex.s: Riding on the only steam engine still working in the southeastern United States is a special treat.
ex.t: 搭乘唯一仍在美国东南部工作的蒸汽机车是一种特殊待遇.
